project.name: Multi-Agent Regulatory Document Assistant
bullets: Built a multi-agent assistant in LangGraph that answers questions over regulatory and policy documents for financial services, combining RAG with vector retrieval, tool use and a supervisor agent.
Evaluated answers with LLM evaluators and release gates for faithfulness and citation quality, then served it through FastAPI in Docker on Kubernetes with tracing and audit logs.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Forward Deployed AI Engineer role in your FS Technology Consulting team. As a Senior GenAI Engineer, I build multi-agent and RAG systems and take them from a first prototype into production alongside the people who will use them. Most of my work has started as a client problem and ended as software running in their environment.

EY's Financial Services practice helps banks, insurers and asset managers build AI they can run themselves, and that hand-over is the part of the job I enjoy most. There is a personal side too. My fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to Dublin together and settle there long term.

At United Health Group I deployed a lab-extraction agent with Claude and Amazon Textract that handles about 1,800 lab documents, and built the evaluation and tracing pipelines that cut human review by 43%. At Viavi I prototyped 15+ AI applications for clients, and 7 went into production or paid work.

Outside work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. It keeps me honest about building for real users and testing carefully before anything ships. I would be glad to talk about how I could help your clients get their AI into production.
